answer.reason: Ekron is a Philistine city where several things happened: the ark of God was sent there and brought deadly destruction, and Ahaziah sought its god Baalzebub.

clauses.english: was where the ark of God brought deadly destruction when the Philistines sent it there
clauses.quote: there was a deadly destruction throughout all the city

clauses.english: was where King Ahaziah sent to enquire of its god Baalzebub, for which the LORD doomed him
clauses.quote: Go, enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease.

doubts: Prophecies of its being rooted up (ZEP 2:4, AMO 1:8) are foretellings, not events, so left out.
JDG 1:18 says Judah took Ekron, but it is a brief mention and was not used; the Philistines' later holding of it is not shown in the verses.
Boundary and city-list verses (JOS 13:3, 15:11, 15:45-46, 19:43) only list the place and were not used.
